radiusSource: Radius 30.035 (27.079 to 33.106) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 20,895,681 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 4.200 (4.160 to 4.240) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4645 +/- 26.5 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 309364127804621696: teff_gspphot 4645.11 K (16th-84th percentiles 4616.86-4669.7627), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 309364127804621696: teff_gspphot 4645.11 K (16th-84th percentiles 4616.86-4669.7627), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
